posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
That is a very loaded question that could range from "How do I set um the sheets properly in a graphic program using premade stuff" to actually drawing or pixealting.
Your best bet is to read the documentation first open the program and read the help file under contents.
Generally, if you are confused, you might just read the whole thing, even though it is a lot, since some stuff basically references things explained elsewhere and it gives you a solid base understanding how to set up tilesets in the database and how the different formats work and have to be formatted on the image files.
It really does not help if you don't tell us which were the parts where you got confused/stuck, since this is a topic where people can run into very different dead ends, so you have to be precise so people know what you need shown or explained
